verdict.rationale: There are only glancing signals. The docs are published per version (a v1-15-21 docs snapshot and an 'edge' API reference for kickoff/status/resume), and the CLI keeps older commands working while printing a yellow deprecation warning, which shows some deprecation handling in practice. Nothing documents a formal deprecation policy or API versioning scheme, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy (timelines, support windows), an explicit API versioning scheme for the REST/AMP API, a published OpenAPI spec or changelog-based compatibility guarantees, and independent corroboration.
